# komodo_docker_registry_account (Data Source)

Fetches a Komodo docker registry account by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing registry account (e.g. created via the UI) by ID.
data "komodo_docker_registry_account" "ghcr" {
  id = "65a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1"
}

output "ghcr_username" {
  value = data.komodo_docker_registry_account.ghcr.username
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Docker registry account ID.

### Read-Only

- `domain` (String) Registry domain.
- `username` (String) Registry account username.
